name: Combat Sector Entry Hazards Regression
description: Deterministic warp/transwarp tests for hostile mines, fighters, and limpets in a suite-owned sector.

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (1, 679), (679, 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
UPDATE players SET sector_id = 1 WHERE name IN ('hazard_victim', 'hazard_master');
UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 1, hull=100, shields=0, fighters=0 WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name IN ('hazard_victim', 'hazard_master'));
DELETE FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679 AND owner_id=@{hazard_master_player_id};

tests.name: Rig: Place hostile mine, fighter, and limpet

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets (sector_id, owner_id, corporation_id, asset_type, quantity, offensive_setting, ttl) VALUES (679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,1,1,0,0),(679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,2,1,1,0),(679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,4,1,0,0);

tests.name: Capture victim turns before refused warp

data.sql: SELECT turns_remaining FROM turns WHERE player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id}

tests.name: Refused warp to unlinked sector changes no state
Verify refused warp left position and assets unchanged

data.sql: SELECT p.sector_id=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679 AND owner_id=@{hazard_master_player_id})=3 FROM players p WHERE p.player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id};
SELECT turns_remaining FROM turns WHERE player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id}

tests.name: Capture victim turns before successful warp

data.sql: SELECT turns_remaining FROM turns WHERE player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id}

tests.name: Victim Warps to Hazard Sector (Multi-Hazard Entry)
Successful warp charges its normal single turn

data.sql: SELECT turns_remaining FROM turns WHERE player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id}

tests.name: Verify attached limpet persists on victim ship

data.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM limpet_attached la JOIN players p ON p.ship_id=la.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id} AND la.owner_player_id=@{hazard_master_player_id});
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE actor_player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id} AND type='combat.hit');
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE actor_player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id} AND type='combat.hit.fighters');
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE actor_player_id=@{hazard_master_player_id} AND type='combat.limpet.attached' AND payload::jsonb->>'target_player_id'='@{hazard_victim_player_id}');

tests.name: Verify all hostile sector assets were consumed

data.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679 AND owner_id=@{hazard_master_player_id});

tests.name: Rig: Restore victim ship and transwarp capability

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=FALSE, has_transwarp=TRUE, hull=100, shields=0, fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='hazard_victim');

tests.name: Rig: Reinstall hostile entry assets for transwarp

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679 AND owner_id=@{hazard_master_player_id};

tests.name: Rig: Add transwarp mine, fighter, and limpet

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets (sector_id, owner_id, corporation_id, asset_type, quantity, offensive_setting, ttl) VALUES (679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,1,1,0,0),(679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,2,1,1,0),(679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,4,1,0,0);
SELECT turns_remaining FROM turns WHERE player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id}

tests.name: Successful transwarp charges its normal single turn

data.sql: SELECT turns_remaining FROM turns WHERE player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id}

tests.name: Limpet attachment remains persistent after repeated sector entry

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM limpet_attached la JOIN players p ON p.ship_id=la.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{hazard_victim_player_id} AND la.owner_player_id=@{hazard_master_player_id};
DELETE FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679 AND owner_id=@{hazard_master_player_id};

INSERT INTO sector_assets (sector_id, owner_id, corporation_id, asset_type, quantity, offensive_setting, ttl) VALUES (679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,1,1,0,0),(679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,2,1,1,0),(679,@{hazard_master_player_id},0,4,1,0,0);
